description: An ADSR envelope generator that runs one independent envelope for every channel of its gate input

params.text: Sets how fast the envelope rises to full, on an exponential scale between 1ms and 10 seconds
Sets how fast the envelope falls from full towards the sustain level, on an exponential scale between 1ms and 10 seconds
Sets the level the envelope falls towards and holds while the gate stays high, 0 to 100 per cent of full
Sets how fast the envelope falls to silence once the gate drops, on an exponential scale between 1ms and 10 seconds

inputs.text: Starts a fresh attack on each rising edge and begins the release when it falls, reading high above 1V and low below 0V; the number of channels here is the number of envelopes that run

outputs.text: The envelope, 0 to 10V, with one channel per channel of the gate

notes: nothing comes out until a gate is patched, since the envelope starts only on a rising edge there
a rising edge partway through the release starts the attack again from the level the envelope had reached, in place of jumping to silence first

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
